title: Gary Swing
intro:
Gary Swing (Green Party) is running for election to the U.S. House to represent Arizona's 6th Congressional District. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the Green Party primary on July 21, 2026.
Swing completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
